observations: All strategies matched the independent fresh-rebuild rank vector at all 1444 effective updates.

relative_2_0 used 43 trigger rebuilds plus 12 one-time initialization rebuilds, versus periodic_32's 41 rebuilds, but summed runtime was 2020.31 ms versus 2100.98 ms and cumulative nonterminal allocations were 67725 versus 103771 in this Python implementation.

relative_2_0 reduced max allocated/live ratio versus always_incremental in all 12 cells. Its worst cell max ratio was 9.29 versus periodic_32's 16.74 and always_incremental's 29.67, although periodic_32 had a slightly lower median max ratio (7.53 versus 7.55).
relative_1_5 lowered the median/worst max ratio further (6.68/8.35) but used 80 trigger rebuilds, showing a clearer memory-versus-rebuild tradeoff.

hybrid_relative2_or_64 added only three trigger rebuilds beyond relative_2_0 (46 vs 43) and did not improve the aggregate worst max ratio; the periodic backstop was not clearly useful in this holdout.
scope: Twelve new n=11,13,15 monotone-game streams. Runtime is implementation/environment-specific; exactness and charged rebuild/allocation counts are the stronger endpoints.
